_about: FAM's App Store Connect text, ready to paste. 'testflight' is what external TestFlight asks for (Test Information, Beta App Review, What to Test); the rest is the App Store version page, needed only at App Store submission - no screenshots are needed for TestFlight. tests/test_app_store_listing.py holds each field to Apple's limit and to APP_STORE.md's rules. <ANGLE> placeholders are filled by the owner in App Store Connect, never here.

testflight.beta_app_description:
FAM turns what you care about into short audio stories.

Ask about anything on Search - type it or say it, pick a length from one to five minutes - and FAM researches it and tells you the story, with its sources on the player. DailyFAM is a page of episodes made for you, trending around the world, and what you missed. myFAM plays mixes of the topics you follow, written fresh every morning. Explore lets you swipe through what other listeners asked for, and you can follow friends, message them an episode and put one on your story with VIBE!.

Episodes are written by AI from current reporting. This beta is for listening on real phones: playback with the screen locked, on the move, and over AirPods.

beta_review.notes:
FAM writes a short audio story in answer to a question. Episodes are written by AI (Anthropic's Claude) from current sources and spoken by our own voice model; sources are shown on the player.

The demo account is a full member, so it skips the pre-launch waitlist that new sign-ups see.

To try it: type a question on Search (for example "how does a heat pump work") and audio starts after a short loading screen. DailyFAM and myFAM are written ahead of time and start immediately. Explore shows episodes other listeners asked for.

Before the first search the app asks permission to send the question to Anthropic to write the episode.

User content: comments, messages, profiles, vibes and episodes can be reported from their menu, and anybody can be blocked from their profile or a chat (Settings > Blocked people undoes it). Reports reach a person and are acted on within 24 hours. The terms are at https://familiarize.net/terms.

Account deletion: Settings > Delete account.

testflight.what_to_test:
Thanks for testing FAM. Please try:
- Search: ask a question, at a few lengths, and listen to the end.
- Lock your phone mid-episode, switch apps, and pull out your AirPods - playback should carry on or pause, never hang.
- Walk from Wi-Fi to cellular during an episode.
- Play something from DailyFAM, and build a mix in myFAM.
- Go Deeper when an episode ends.
Anything wrong, slow or confusing: take a screenshot in TestFlight and send it - it reaches us with the build.

subtitle: Keep up, in short audio
promotional_text: Ask about anything and hear the story in a few minutes. Follow your teams, markets and topics, and FAM has the latest ready for you every morning.
description:
Ask about anything, and FAM tells you the story in audio - researched, current and short enough to hear on the way to wherever you're going.

Keeping up takes work, so most of us miss the conversation. FAM turns what you care about into audio stories, so you can be part of it.

SEARCH: ASK FOR EXACTLY THE EPISODE YOU WANT
Type or say your question the way you'd ask a friend who knows everything. Pick how long you want to listen, from one minute to five, and FAM researches it and tells you the story. Every episode is built from current sources, and you can see who it read on the player.
- Choose your length, from a quick minute to a deeper listen
- Go Deeper: when an episode ends, FAM suggests the likeliest follow-up, or ask your own
- Read along with captions as you listen

DAILYFAM: A PAGE THAT REFRESHES ALL DAY
DailyFAM is always full of up-to-date episodes, so there's something worth hearing every time you open it.
- Made for you, from what you like to hear about
- Trending stories from around the world
- What you missed while you were busy
- What's popular on FAM and with your friends
- Pick up where you left off

MYFAM: YOUR TOPICS, MIXED AND PLAYED IN ONE TAP
Build mixes from the topics you follow - a team, a market, a field you work in - and FAM writes the latest on each of them every morning.
- One tap plays through it all, back to back
- Share your mixes, or copy one somebody else made
- Add any episode's topic to a mix from the player

EXPLORE: HEAR WHAT EVERYONE ELSE IS ASKING
Swipe through episodes other listeners asked for. Like, comment, save for later, or share one with a friend.

LISTEN TOGETHER
Follow your friends, see what they're hearing, and send an episode in a message. Put an episode on your story with VIBE!, and reply to a friend's.

MADE TO BE HEARD
- Keeps playing when you leave the screen or lock your phone
- Skip back or ahead 15 seconds, or drag to any point you've reached
- Change the speed without changing the voice
- Save episodes for later and sort them into your own folders

HOW FAM WRITES
Episodes are written by AI from current reporting and the sources are listed with every episode. FAM asks before it sends your first question to be written. When something hasn't happened yet, FAM says so instead of guessing.

YOUR ACCOUNT
Sign up with email, Google or Apple. You can delete your account and everything in it from Settings at any time. You can report any comment, message or profile, and block anybody.
